company.description: Scaphold is the world's most powerful GraphQL as a service platform. The platform will provide a number of services including push notifications, analytics, file storage, custom code, multiple environments, and more to allow developers to build mobile, web, and IOT applications. Their innovative use of GraphQL is the big game changer here. They are convinced that it’s the future of APIs and they want to make it readily accessible to everyone else.
